prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: portrait front cover for the Inner Strength Institute workplace handbook, displayed in an internal counseling practice app. Create a finished, beautifully typeset professional editorial cover, approximately 3:4 portrait. Upper half warm ivory paper, deep navy typography, subtle forest green accents. Lower half an elegant watercolor and fine architectural line illustration of a tranquil Colorado counseling room: two comfortable chairs, a small table, plants, floor-to-ceiling windows opening to evergreen foothills and distant Rocky Mountain peaks. Calm, refined, welcoming, realistic restrained illustration; no people, no school desks, no tutoring, no sports equipment. Generous whitespace and confident hierarchy. Exact text only: small uppercase organization name at top "INNER STRENGTH INSTITUTE"; large title across two lines "WORKPLACE" and "HANDBOOK"; small descriptor "Counseling • Care • Professional Practice"; at bottom "HEAL  |  GROW  |  PERFORM  |  BELONG". All typography must be crisp, readable and spelled exactly. No founding date, no other logos or fake seals, no download buttons, no mockup background or book perspective: full flat cover art to its edges. Navy #0b1f3a, forest green #2f6b3a, warm ivory, sage and soft mountain blue.
